name: Potage Parmentier (Smooth Leek & Potato Soup)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Wonder · Triton's
whyItWorks: Peeled potatoes and tender simmered leeks are pureed into a velvety, liquid-smooth French bisque that requires zero mechanical chewing.
prepOrOrderInstructions: At Lumiere's or Triton's, order without raw chive garnish or crunchy croutons. At home, simmer peeled potatoes in broth with onion powder and blend smooth with lactose-free cream and butter.
watchOuts: Dairy cream base if lactose sensitive
